assets.prompt: Create ONE wide 3:1 landscape illustration sheet, EXACTLY THREE equally sized square scenes horizontally, edge to edge, no borders, gutters or text. Each scene independently framed within its own square. Warm watercolor and gouache Japanese everyday-life storybook, delicate paper, rich soft colors, clear expressive faces, beautiful detailed environments, natural proportions. Hana is a young Japanese woman with short dark bob, cream blouse and coral cardigan. Yui is her friend with long dark hair and navy dress over cream blouse. No lettering, numerals, written signs, logos or speech bubbles. Left: Hana and mother unpack cardboard boxes in a sunny small new apartment. Center: Hana with an umbrella asks a kind elderly neighbor directions in an apartment hallway. Right: Hana and Yui drink tea on cushions beside the window overlooking a small leafy park.
